messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: hosted-api p99 latency spike detected in us-east-1 and eu-west-1. request_queue.size > 15k for 3m, gpu_pool_utilization = 99%. Autoscaler showing repeated create failures. Paging on-call. :rotating_light:

maria: i'm on it, looking at the autoscaler logs and instance creation traces. seeing immediate 403 quota errors from cloud provider when trying to spin up g4/g5 nodes.

sanjay: confirmed — quota error: 
```
403 QuotaExceeded: Could not create instance: Insufficient quota for region us-east-1: GPUs
request id=abcd-1234
```

taylor: oncall here. what's the customer impact? any 5xx spikes?

maria: yes — hosted-api 502/504s for some requests. P95 rose from 120ms to 2.1s, p99 ~ 6.4s, and a handful of client timeouts. Non-critical routes are buffered but some low-tenancy customers are getting errors.

ben: can we fail traffic to smaller quantized model variants while autoscaler resolves? we have rts-friendly small-llama-q4 variants that use less GPU mem.

alex: we can fallback via routing policy. I can flip a feature-flag to prefer q4-small for non-enterprise routes. doing a quick risk check.

emily: +1 to fallback. also want to open manual capacity request with cloud (support ticket) but that takes time. need immediate mitigations first.

maria: mitigation plan: 1) enable routing fallback to q4-small for all non-enterprise keys; 2) soft-throttle large batch requests; 3) manually scale up one dedicated warm pool for critical traffic (if quota allows) and move canary customers there; 4) escalate quota to cloud.

alex: toggling routing flag now for non-enterprise. will watch for error rates.

deploy-bot: flag toggle: routing.fallback.q4-small -> true (by alex)

maria: toggled — seeing immediate drop in queue growth for the routes we flipped. overall queue still around 9k and slowly declining. p99 down to ~3.2s on most routes.

ben: executing soft-throttle: applying token bucket to /v1/generate that limits requests > 1k tokens to 30r/s.

sanjay: attempted manual pool create but hit the same quota. cloud support response: "we're throttling quota increase requests in this account due to recent high usage patterns — emergency request submitted." ETA unknown.

emily: can we evict largest batched jobs first? those are the main queue hogs.

maria: yes — identifying top 10 requesters by shard and marking for eviction. also enabling prefix-KV cache for high-hit clients to reduce re-tokenization.

alex: after fallback and throttle, error rate for timeouts is down ~60%. we still have p99 ~2.4s for some heavy routes but no new 502 alerts.

ben: handoff note for next oncall: taylor -> ben in 30m. if queue doesn't drop below 2k, escalate to product ops to open customer comms.

emily: tagging affected customers list from monitoring: customer-ids [cust-112, cust-399, cust-881]. we should prep a short status blurb for CSMs if we hit SLA thresholds.

maria: summary of root causes so far: sudden traffic burst + large batched requests -> GPU pool saturated. autoscaler attempted to create nodes but cloud quota prevents provisioning -> autoscaler repeatedly retries and doesn't recover. fallback routing worked to avert widespread 5xxs.

taylor: leaving a short checklist for handoff: 
- ensure routing.fallback remains on until autoscaler can create capacity
- continue soft-throttle on large requests
- monitor queue.size and p99 in us-east-1 / eu-west-1 every 5m
- if queue > 5k during handoff, escalate to infra-lead (sanjay) and product ops

maria: also created support ticket #SUP-8723 with cloud, included logs and spike evidence.

sanjay: pending cloud reply. opening internal infra escalation too (quota ops). we can consider temporarily adding GPU capacity in another org account and routing traffic there but that's riskier.

alex: quick note — if we route to another region, watch token-currency and multi-tenant isolation flags. need to ensure keys mapped correctly.

ben: agreed. for now keep fallback and throttles. preparing standard customer comms template.

emily: will draft a short status update for CSMs once we confirm queue <2k.

maria: current status at handoff (3519877800): queue 1.9k, p99 ~1.6s, autoscaler still failing to create nodes (quota). fallback active, throttles active. handing to ben for overnight.

ben: taking over oncall. i'm adding an estimate for mitigation timeline and will update here hourly. if anything changes ping me directly. :thumbsup:
